-- Get sales for both period 4s by store
SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  s.store_id,
  s.store_name,
  SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
WHERE d.fiscal_period = 4 
  AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2026/27')
  AND s.store_id NOT IN (900, 999)  -- Exclude web shop and training store
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, s.store_id, s.store_name
ORDER BY s.store_id, d.fiscal_year;

-- Calculate like-for-like growth for period 4
-- Only include stores with sales in BOTH FY2025/26 P04 and FY2026/27 P04
WITH sales_by_store_year AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    s.store_id,
    s.store_name,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  WHERE d.fiscal_period = 4 
    AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2026/27')
    AND s.store_id NOT IN (900, 999)
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, s.store_id, s.store_name
),
lfl_stores AS (
  SELECT store_id, store_name
  FROM sales_by_store_year
  WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
  INTERSECT
  SELECT store_id, store_name
  FROM sales_by_store_year
  WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
),
lfl_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    s.store_id,
    s.store_name,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  JOIN lfl_stores lfl ON s.store_id = lfl.store_id
  WHERE d.fiscal_period = 4 
    AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2026/27')
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, s.store_id, s.store_name
)
SELECT 
  MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN net_sales END) as fy2025_26_sales,
  MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' THEN net_sales END) as fy2026_27_sales,
  ROUND(100.0 * (MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' THEN net_sales END) - MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN net_sales END)) / MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN net_sales END), 2) as lfl_growth_pct
FROM lfl_sales
GROUP BY store_id, store_name
ORDER BY store_id;

-- Calculate overall like-for-like growth for period 4
WITH sales_by_year AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  WHERE d.fiscal_period = 4 
    AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2026/27')
    AND s.store_id NOT IN (900, 999, 129)  -- Exclude web shop, training store, and Savonlinna (closed)
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year
)
SELECT 
  fiscal_year,
  ROUND(net_sales, 2) as net_sales
FROM sales_by_year
ORDER BY fiscal_year;

-- Calculate like-for-like growth by region for period 4
-- Only include stores that had sales in BOTH FY2025/26 P04 and FY2026/27 P04
WITH sales_by_store_year AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    s.region,
    s.store_id,
    s.store_name,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  WHERE d.fiscal_period = 4 
    AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2026/27')
    AND s.store_id NOT IN (900, 999)
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, s.region, s.store_id, s.store_name
),
lfl_stores AS (
  SELECT store_id
  FROM sales_by_store_year
  WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
  INTERSECT
  SELECT store_id
  FROM sales_by_store_year
  WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
),
lfl_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    s.region,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  JOIN lfl_stores lfl ON s.store_id = lfl.store_id
  WHERE d.fiscal_period = 4 
    AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2026/27')
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, s.region
)
SELECT 
  region,
  MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN net_sales END) as fy2025_26_sales,
  MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' THEN net_sales END) as fy2026_27_sales,
  ROUND(100.0 * (MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' THEN net_sales END) - MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN net_sales END)) / MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN net_sales END), 2) as lfl_growth_pct
FROM lfl_sales
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY region;

-- Overall like-for-like growth with all regions combined
WITH sales_by_store_year AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    s.store_id,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  WHERE d.fiscal_period = 4 
    AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2026/27')
    AND s.store_id NOT IN (900, 999)
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, s.store_id
),
lfl_stores AS (
  SELECT store_id
  FROM sales_by_store_year
  WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
  INTERSECT
  SELECT store_id
  FROM sales_by_store_year
  WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
),
lfl_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  JOIN lfl_stores lfl ON s.store_id = lfl.store_id
  WHERE d.fiscal_period = 4 
    AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2026/27')
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year
)
SELECT 
  'Total Like-for-Like' as measurement,
  MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN net_sales END) as fy2025_26_sales,
  MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' THEN net_sales END) as fy2026_27_sales,
  ROUND(100.0 * (MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' THEN net_sales END) - MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN net_sales END)) / MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN net_sales END), 2) as lfl_growth_pct
FROM lfl_sales;

-- Verify store closure timing relative to period 4 dates
SELECT 
  store_id,
  store_name, 
  close_date,
  '2025-07-28' as p4_fy2025_26_start,
  '2025-08-24' as p4_fy2025_26_end,
  '2026-08-03' as p4_fy2026_27_start,
  '2026-08-30' as p4_fy2026_27_end,
  CASE 
    WHEN close_date IS NULL THEN 'Open in both periods'
    WHEN close_date < '2025-07-28' THEN 'Closed before both periods'
    WHEN close_date >= '2025-07-28' AND close_date < '2025-08-24' THEN 'Closed during P4 FY2025/26'
    WHEN close_date >= '2025-08-24' AND close_date < '2026-08-03' THEN 'Closed between the two periods'
    WHEN close_date >= '2026-08-03' AND close_date < '2026-08-30' THEN 'Closed during P4 FY2026/27'
    ELSE 'Closed after both periods'
  END as closure_timing
FROM dim_store
WHERE close_date IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY store_id;
